Dov Benyaacov-Kurtzman Your comments here started by reciting PIBA propaganda about how relatives are not "regular tourists" and not "genuine tourists". But then said you are actually against this sentiment, and that family should be allowed in normally for a visit. So I *suggested* that next time you don't align yourself so much with PIBA's idea of what is allowed or not allowed to begin with. It's not ordering, it's pointing out a contradiction in what you wrote. 

As to my articulation, this is a Facebook comment section in the middle of a work day. This is not meant to be sophisticated. I promise I articulate myself better on the legal papers I write lol
